_comment: A draft of the VAREK dashboard for Google Security Operations' native dashboards (v1.44, step 2; integrations/secops/README.md). Its panels are YARA-L 2.0 queries over what varek_secops.py writes (tests/test_varek_secops_content.py checks each field). It is imported and drawn in the development instance at the ship gate, then exported from there, and that export replaces this file.

dashboard.description: Refusals by policy line, agent and run; dry runs; failed audits; approvals nobody gave in time

charts.query:
$e.metadata.vendor_name = "Sober Agentic Infrastructure"
$e.metadata.product_name = "VAREK"
$e.security_result.action = "BLOCK"
$decided_by = $e.security_result.rule_name
$text = $e.security_result.summary
match:
  $decided_by, $text
outcome:
  $refusals = count($e.metadata.product_log_id)
  $runs = count_distinct($e.additional.fields["varek_run"])
order:
  $refusals desc
limit:
  25

$e.metadata.vendor_name = "Sober Agentic Infrastructure"
$e.metadata.product_name = "VAREK"
$e.security_result.action = "BLOCK"
$agent = $e.principal.application
match:
  $agent
outcome:
  $refusals = count($e.metadata.product_log_id)
order:
  $refusals desc
limit:
  25

$e.metadata.vendor_name = "Sober Agentic Infrastructure"
$e.metadata.product_name = "VAREK"
$e.security_result.action = "BLOCK"
$run = $e.additional.fields["varek_run"]
$host = $e.principal.hostname
match:
  $run, $host
outcome:
  $refusals = count($e.metadata.product_log_id)
  $last = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
order:
  $last desc
limit:
  25

$e.metadata.vendor_name = "Sober Agentic Infrastructure"
$e.metadata.product_name = "VAREK"
$e.security_result.action = "BLOCK"
$hour = timestamp.get_timestamp($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds, "%Y-%m-%d %H:00")
match:
  $hour
outcome:
  $refusals = count($e.metadata.product_log_id)
order:
  $hour asc

$e.metadata.vendor_name = "Sober Agentic Infrastructure"
$e.metadata.product_name = "VAREK"
$e.security_result.action = "BLOCK"
$id = $e.metadata.product_log_id
match:
  $id
outcome:
  $time = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
  $host = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
  $agent = array_distinct($e.principal.application)
  $decided_by = array_distinct($e.security_result.rule_name)
  $file = array_distinct($e.target.file.full_path)
  $reached = array_distinct($e.target.hostname)
order:
  $time desc
limit:
  50

charts.displayName: Dry runs: let through, not enforced
charts.query:
$e.metadata.vendor_name = "Sober Agentic Infrastructure"
$e.metadata.product_name = "VAREK"
$e.additional.fields["varek_mode"] = "dry_run"
$e.additional.fields["varek_decision"] = "DENY"
$run = $e.additional.fields["varek_run"]
$decided_by = $e.security_result.rule_name
match:
  $run, $decided_by
outcome:
  $let_through = count($e.metadata.product_log_id)
order:
  $let_through desc
limit:
  25

$e.metadata.vendor_name = "Sober Agentic Infrastructure"
$e.metadata.product_name = "VAREK"
$e.additional.fields["varek_event"] = "audit"
$e.additional.fields["varek_audit_passed"] = "false"
$run = $e.additional.fields["varek_run"]
match:
  $run
outcome:
  $time = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
  $host = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
  $mode = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["varek_audit_mode"])
  $problems = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["varek_audit_problems"])
order:
  $time desc

$e.metadata.vendor_name = "Sober Agentic Infrastructure"
$e.metadata.product_name = "VAREK"
($e.additional.fields["varek_event"] = "step_up_end" or $e.additional.fields["varek_event"] = "defer_end")
$e.additional.fields["varek_ending"] = "timeout"
$run = $e.additional.fields["varek_run"]
$line = $e.additional.fields["varek_policy_line"]
match:
  $run, $line
outcome:
  $expired = count($e.metadata.product_log_id)
  $waits = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["varek_event"])
order:
  $expired desc
limit:
  25
